old_value: {"id":"PKIX-cf0b","title":"pkix-lint: OSCAL profile resolver silently drops unknown control IDs","description":"Skoll REVIEW MEDIUM-12 finding (PKIX-szmo.7 triage). In pkix-lint/src/oscal/profile.rs around line 334, resolve_profile uses available_ids.retain(|id| wanted.contains(id)) which silently drops any control ID present in the Profile's include-controls but absent from the source Catalog. A typo in a Profile JSON control ID is silently ignored rather than surfaced as an error.
